writing_principles.entry_rule: On ne simplifie pas l'idée. On simplifie son point d'entrée.
writing_principles.human_depth_target: Je comprends parfaitement ce qu'ils vivent. Je ne suis pas certain de ce que j'en pense.
writing_principles.cross_pillar_rule: Prefer systems and scenes that express several pillars at once while remaining causally and historically coherent.

pillars.name: Création de personnages
pillars.rule: Le monde possède son histoire ; le joueur y crée la personne qui va la traverser.
requirements: creation is structurally integrated into play rather than detached cosmetics
identity is recognized by systems narrative equipment injuries progression and persistent body consequences
humans may belong to all ethnicities without intrinsic stat stereotypes
appearance sex skin and ethnicity never grant intrinsic build bonuses
optional origins may enrich roleplay but do not permanently lock the build
major historical figures may remain predefined exceptions
pillars.litd1: Created/customized playable characters are structural to the roster alongside recruitment, classes, three skill trees, equipment, traits, injuries, permadeath and captured creatures.
pillars.litd2: The protagonist is created by the player and is not Sahra, Ilyan or Tala. Identity remains stable through Remanence reconstruction and old corpses remain recognizable.

pillars.name: Gore systémique et conséquences corporelles
pillars.rule: Violence doit raconter ce qui est arrivé au corps, pas seulement produire un effet décoratif.
requirements: body zones matter
injury trauma fractures dismemberment and finishers remain readable
visible body state and corpses preserve consequences
gore connects to gameplay and narrative systems
violence is never gratuitous shorthand for depth

pillars.name: Philosophie et psychologie dans la narration
pillars.entry_method: concrete situation -> character conflict -> choice/consequence -> optional deeper interpretation
guardrails: no essay-speakers or authorial correct answer
trauma neither inevitably breaks nor strengthens
post-traumatic growth is optional and never makes trauma good
moral injury is treated as a developing construct
Freud and Jung are historical/symbolic references, not empirical consensus
Maslow is not a fixed universal ladder
Milgram does not prove everyone inevitably obeys
Stanford prison does not justify simple situational determinism
supernatural Folie is distinct from real mental illness
mental illness is never shorthand for violence evil or supernatural insight

voices.Tala: concrete case -> institution; focuses on arbitrary power and contestability
voices.Sahra: body practice limits and consequences; force is not legitimacy
voices.Ilyan: perception experience doubt memory and creation; separates observation from interpretation

pillars.name: Profondeur humaine accessible
pillars.target_effect: Je comprends parfaitement ce qu'ils vivent. Je ne suis pas certain de ce que j'en pense.
validation_questions: Do I understand what the character is living?
Do I understand what they want or fear?
Is there still something meaningful to think about afterward?

pillars.name: Narration forte
requirements: clear plot and understandable objectives
memorable characters with motivated evolution
mysteries whose revelations are prepared
consequences persist
emotional progression
secondary stories tied to the world
environmental storytelling
procedural or roguelike structure never excuses vague history
runs and deaths obey real chronology

pillars.name: Interconnexion des jeux
pillars.rule: Each game enriches the others while remaining independently understandable.
pillars.past_to_future_trace_rule: A validated past event should leave an appropriate future trace unless a documented cause explains its absence.

global_rules.name: Cohérence narrative absolue
global_rules.rule: Rien n'arrive parce que le scénario l'exige. Tout arrive parce que le monde, les personnages et les règles déjà établies le permettent.
global_rules.final_test: Si le joueur connaissait toutes les informations disponibles dans le canon, cette explication lui semblerait-elle naturelle plutôt que fabriquée après coup ?
